description:
V3.1ir brings the biggest update to the Mini yet. The frame now uses the same rack-mounting system as the Cargo and Mini-Max, opening the door for upgrades such as the tilting rack bracket. The rack itself has been redesigned with round tubing for a cleaner look, and for dynamo-light compatibility. With the new rack comes new webbing, using the v2 dual-axis design for the round-tube rack that also comes with the Nano.

For the update, we’re also introducing the V3.1 fork, which has already been added to the Cargo and Mini-Max models.

The Titanium Mini retains it’s horizontal top tube for a sportier feel to the smallest size.

The Mini almost speaks for itself. It’s a normal bike with a front rack on steroids!

It‘s manageable size makes handling familiar, and multimodal transportation a breeze. The rack is ideal for getting around with a load too big for a backpack, and perfect for putting it out front where you can keep an eye on it.

We like to think this is the most playful cargo bike out there!

Significant loads on the mini are a non-issue as long as they are more or less kept within the rack‘s size. The weight of the load has very little influence on steering, giving you surprising amounts of confidence, as the rack‘s support is built directly into the frame.

Titanium is unmatched: it won’t rust, crack, or corrode, no matter the conditions. It’s lighter than steel but just as tough, delivering a smooth, responsive ride with zero maintenance fuss. Simply put — steel is real, but titanium is realer.

Getting the perfect fit makes all the difference in how your Omnium feels and performs. Use the chart to find the frame size that best matches your height.

Each Omnium frame size covers a range of rider heights, so if you’re between sizes, consider how you like your bike to feel:

With On-Demand OMNIUM titanium frames are made to order and finished to your preference as a frame kit or complete, based on your wishes.

Choose model, complete or frame kit, size, decal or anodizing, optional titanium and carbon parts and any accessories – Once the frame arrives it will be built up to your chosen specifications.

We open up orders for Titanium On-Demand 4 times a year and lead time starts when the on-demand window closes – See the on-demand order schedule for the next windows.

Frame kits are quicker to build up and will start shipping first. All bikes are shipped within 2 weeks of arrival.

The order window for Titanium bikes will be open in the following periods

Geometry is the same across steel and titanium but tubing is changed to add more stiffness to the titanium frame.

The Mini V3.1 uses the same rack-mounting specs as the Cargo and Mini-Max, opening the door for upgrades such as the tilting rack bracket – Because if the changes to the mounting interface, the Mini v3.1 is not able to accommodate the the square tube rack from previus Mini interations
